atAGlance: Trà lài is jasmine tea, fragrant and clean, part of the Vietnamese habit of using tea for welcome, pause, and conversation.
whatItIs: Trà lài is tea scented with jasmine blossoms. Expect jasmine tea with a fragrant floral nose, light body, and clean tea bitterness.
howToEnjoy: Pair it with snacks or a meal when you want something aromatic but not heavy.
howLocalsOrder: Trà lài is ordered by temperature and sweetness. Ask ít đường or ít đá before the glass is made, because Vietnamese tea drinks can arrive sweeter and icier than expected.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese tea shops, trà lài is one of the easiest floral teas to recognize because jasmine scent rises before the first sip.
goodToKnow: Can be plain or sweetened depending on the shop.
